explication: This is a Claude Code plugin that delegates reviews and coding tasks to Codex. The principal workflow is: a Claude user invokes a slash command, the companion resolves review or task context, optionally records a background job, sends work through the Codex app-server runtime, persists status/results, and renders output back to Claude. Distinct stages include command dispatch, target preparation, execution, job lifecycle, and result presentation. The graph also includes session transfer and the optional stop-time review gate. Some command wiring is inferred from the README and tree; unsampled implementation links are omitted.
